motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Bureau of Sanitation (LASAN), in coordination with Council District 14, to prioritize, for the next 60 days, sanitation requests in Council District 14 for bulky item pick up, street sweeping and powerwashing, and dead animal removal in the public right of way, which includes but is not limited to alleys and sidewalks located within the community of Boyle Heights. I FURTHER MOVE that LASAN, in coordination with Council District 14, prioritize and target street sweeping, power washing and bulky item removal in alleys and sidewalks nearby schools within the community of Boyle Heights, with the understanding that this directive is limited to sanitation and maintenance activities and does not authorize or constitute enforcement under LAMC 41.18 or any other ordinance regulating sitting, lying, or sleeping in the public right-of-way.
